maya_singh: Heads-up — proposing Rainfall (dedicated) cutover to runtime v2.7.1-q4. Proposed window: Tue 2026-05-12 02:00-04:00 UTC (low traffic). Plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation between ramps. Rollback criteria: error rate > 2% OR latency p95 +300ms vs baseline for >10m. Will pin model to v2.7.1-q4 on the tenant slice. Need: SRE + infra + CS sign-off. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/rainfall-cutover (private). @alex_kaplan @jamie_chen @lina_cs @deploybot

deploybot: Scheduled canary job #rb-2249. Steps:
- 02:00 UTC: canary 5% (slice: rainfall-canary)
- 02:20 UTC: evaluate metrics & release gates
- 02:35 UTC: ramp to 25% if gates pass
- 02:50 UTC: ramp to 100% if stable
Auto-rollback: enabled. Manual override allowed via /deploy cancel <job-id>.

jamie_chen: Quick Q — are we pre-warming KV cache for the canary? Rainfall has long-context traffic spikes, want to avoid cold-cache P95 spikes. Also suggest increase canary observation to 20m between 5% -> 25%.

alex_kaplan: Runtime hotfix fwd-aten-kernel included in 2.7.1-q4. KV prewarm job is in the runbook, can kick off prewarm + tenancy warmup 30m pre-window. Recommend keeping batching conservative during canary (batch_size cap = 8). I'll pin model variant id: rainfall-v7@sha256:9f3a for the migration.

lina_cs: CS note — Rainfall PM requested a 48h heads-up and expects a short maintenance note to users. I sent an initial heads-up email earlier today; will follow up with final window and rollback expectations if you confirm.

maya_singh: Added KV prewarm step and extended canary observation to 20m. Edited runbook to include ops checklist and customer notification template. Also: fallback target if rollback is triggered = runtime v2.6.9 + model rainfall-v6@sha256:1b2c.

jamie_chen: +1 SRE, monitoring hooks, trace sampling, and synthetic traffic (2 qps per slice) configured. Will watch p50/p95/p99, errors, and redis misses. If p95 > baseline + 300ms for 12m, we trigger manual rollback immediately.

alex_kaplan: +1 infra/runtime — will pin on deploy. Batching prewarm disabled for canary. Capacity check: dedicated pool has 12% spare headroom, sufficient for Rainfall slice at 25% ramp.

lina_cs: +1 CS — Rainfall notified and OK with window. Asking support on-call to stand by.

maya_singh: Requesting final thumbs: SRE, infra, CS. If we get all +1s by EOD tomorrow we’ll lock window and notify execs.

sre_oncall_bot: deploybot triggered: canary job rb-2249 queued for 2026-05-12T02:00:00Z. CI smoke passed (smoke-134).

jamie_chen: one more ask — add a temporary traffic-split alert to pager if canary error rate crosses 1.2% so we don’t wait too long to react.

maya_singh: Done. Added pager rule: Rainfall-Canary-Errors > 1.2% for 3m -> pg:oncall-sre.

jamie_chen: final +1.

alex_kaplan: final +1.

lina_cs: final +1, will send final customer note 48h before window.

deploybot: rb-2249 status: SCHEDULED (02:00 UTC 2026-05-12). Canary slices: rainfall-canary (5%), rainfall-slice-1 (25% pending). Auto-rollback target: v2.6.9. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/rainfall-cutover.

maya_singh: Locked window and notifying execs + legal. Thanks all — please keep on-call channels open during the window. If anything changes ping me directly. :rocket:
